full_judgment: 12. The present appellant that is defendant No.5 filed written statements in the said suit contending that the suit is bad for misjoinder of parties, the defendant No.5 is neither a borrower nor a guarantor nor a mortgagor against the loan availed by the plaintiff and as such the suit is liable to be dismissed. The Bank Asia Ltd. in its written statement further contended that on 27.05.2003 they requested the plaintiff to inform whether security interest over the defendant nots assets can be shared on pad passu basis, but the plaintiff never disclosed the security taken or to be taken against the credit facilities, the defendant No.5 as a result conducted due diligence on the records of the plaintiff maintained with RJSC, the plaintiff furnished Bank Asia Ltd. wrong information vide their letter dated r 06.11.2003 about the security taken against the facility extended by the plaintiff which was found false the plaintiff never disclosed to the defendant No.5, Bank Asia Ltd. the security obtained/to be obtained against the term loan limit.
